You need a sign-off from the **Growth team**. Post the change in **#growth-eng**, and any Growth engineer can approve it.

The Growth team has owned the notifier since 2026-09-01. Dana Okafor used to own it and approved template changes back then, but she has moved to Platform. The team's shared memory store still has the old "Dana owns it" note, but it's already marked as replaced by the Growth one. The repo itself has no CODEOWNERS file or other ownership record for the notifier to check against.

One thing to watch when you edit the copy: each template in `services/notifier/templates/` has an HTML version (`<event>.mjml`) and a plain-text version (`<event>.txt`). Make the same change in both. The plain-text one matters because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML, so those recipients only see the `.txt` version.
